elly-cs: Quick heads-up — Celestia account: p95 latency up ~18% WoW on /v1/generate, error rate still low but tail spikes in afternoons. Usage +20% (now ~52k req/day).

mike-ops: Thanks — any infra/config changes last week?

elly-cs: They bumped client batch size and rolled to 3 replicas last Tue. Also seeing more long-context calls (avg tokens -> 620). Suspect KV cache churn + longer decoding windows.

tayla-ml: @elly-cs can you paste a few tail prompts? If sequence length shifted, we should route short queries to a compact quantized variant and keep long ones on base. Int8 could cut token latency/cost a lot.

elly-cs: Pasting a quick perf summary and a minimal routing proposal below (idea: short -> compact-int8, long -> base-fp16).

```
perf_summary:
  avg_tokens: 620
  p95_latency: +18% WoW
  peak_qps: 2400

routing_policy_proposal:
  - if tokens <= 512 -> model: compact-1, quant: int8, remark: "saves ~35% token time"
  - else -> model: base-1, quant: fp16
  - fallback -> model: base-1
```

ana-se: Need to capture a quick QA checklist before we shift traffic: hallucination regression test, PII handling validation, and a rollback plan. Also confirm SLA impact for their dedicated pool.

tayla-ml: Agreed. Suggest A/B canary: 10% short-query traffic to compact-1 for 48h, measure top-k accuracy, token-level latency, and cost per 1k tokens. I'll wire eval harness to compare for top intents.

elly-cs: Canary command I'll ask infra to run once we have PM approval:

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/routes/canary" -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD" -d '{"account":"celestia","model":"compact-1","fraction":0.1,"criteria":{"max_halluc_rate":0.02}}'
```

deploy-bot: deploy request created: #deploy-2734 -> canary compact-1 (dedicated pool) scheduled in 30m :rocket:

mike-ops: I'll pre-warm KV cache and add a short-lived prefix cache for common intents, watching p95 and error budget. Will also throttle if QPS > 3k.

elly-cs: I'll loop in Celestia PM for sign-off on the canary and the QA checklist. Target mid-week roll if canary looks good. Thanks all :thumbsup:

tayla-ml: I'll prepare evaluation dashboards and a small regression alert (if top-intent F1 drops >3%).

ana-se: Once PM signs, I'll handle compliance sign-off and note in the renewal tracker that we proactively offered perf optimization (good renewal signal).

elly-cs: Filing this as a PSR (proactive service recommendation) for Celestia. Follow-ups: confirm PM approval, start canary, monitor evals + infra.\/end
